description: Complex/dynamic form handling — conditional dependent fields + required-field validation. /orders/new: choosing a country populates the region dropdown (JS), and region is required. Tests re-perception after a DOM mutation + filling all required fields + verifying the result.

scenarios.goal: Log in, then place a new order: open the new order form, choose the country 'United States', then choose a region from the region dropdown that appears, fill in any other required fields, and submit the order. Confirm the order was placed.
